packageRules.description: Every non-major update lands in one weekly PR, across all workspaces and managers. The monorepo shares one pnpm-lock.yaml, so any split turns each merge into a rebase for the rest.
Majors wait on the Dependency Dashboard until ticked. Each needs code changes, and inside the weekly batch one breaking change would hold back every patch.
Below 1.0 a minor is a breaking release under semver, so it is handled like a major: its own PR, opened from the dashboard.
Action majors are mostly runtime bumps; once ticked they land together.
The overrides in pnpm-workspace.yaml each pin a patched line for a stated reason and are retired by hand once upstream catches up, so Renovate leaves them alone.
